parameters.name: actionStatus
parameters.description: Fetch documents with an action status

parameters.name: syncStatus
parameters.description: Fetch documents with an sync status

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Deprecated: use softDeleted. Fetch soft deleted documents

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Fetch documents inserted on a certain date (yyyy-MM-dd)

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: UTC offset to apply to date parameter (IE: -0600)

parameters.name: projection
parameters.description: Specify a restricted document projection. Use 'DOCUMENT_ID_ONLY' to return only the documentId attribute.
